entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Friends?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I don't need anyone like that!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Here... I'll show you who I really am.
entries.uk: Ось... Я покажу вам, хто я насправді.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Come!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Loki!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Again—it's that Persona!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Haaaaaa!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What's going on!?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Don't make me laugh!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Justice? Righteous!? Keep that shit to yourselves!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You and your teammates piss me off!
entries.uk: Ти й твої товариші мене бісите!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He can use two separate powers!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Then everything... even his appearance was a fake!
entries.uk: Тоді все... навіть його зовнішність[n]була підробкою!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You're going down... I'll destroy you...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Go down with me!
entries.uk: Підеш на дно разом зі мною!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No way...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That bastard... He made himself go psychotic!
entries.uk: От покидьок... Він сам довів себе[n]до психозу!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Now, let's see you drop dead one at a[n]time, in front of your precious friends!
entries.uk: А тепер подивимося, як ви здихатимете[n]один за одним на очах у своїх дорогих[n]друзів!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Dammit, he's lost it! Here it comes!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Diiiiiiiiie!!!!!
